name: brand_analytics_create_user_intent_cluster
description:
Creates a single intent cluster for a company (a row in etl.ba_user_intents_current) and persists the search_term mappings (rows in etl.ba_search_term_to_intent_current). Consequential.

Workflow position: STEP 5 of the intent-clustering flow.
  - Pipeline: brand_analytics_analyze_search_query_performance → brand_analytics_list_user_intent_clusters (coverage) → brand_analytics_cluster_search_terms (returns clustering_run_id + instructions) → agent LLM proposes intents → THIS TOOL once per proposed intent → brand_analytics_list_user_intent_clusters to verify.
  - Pass `clustering_run_id` on EVERY call for the run so the audit row in intent_cluster_audit is finalized (status=completed, output_intents_count incremented).
  - Provide `llm_audit_payload` on the FIRST call of the run only, to record the model + token usage that produced the proposals.

Uniqueness (app-enforced): (company_id, intent_id). The tool rejects duplicates with a clear error.

Supports dry_run=true (default) to validate inputs without writing.

Example:
{
  "company_id": 103,
  "clustering_run_id": 1715000000000123,
  "intent_id": "plantar_fasciitis_relief",
  "intent_name": "Plantar Fasciitis Relief",
  "customer_need": "Reduce heel pain caused by plantar fasciitis while walking or standing.",
  "source": "llm_proposed",
  "dry_run": false,
  "search_terms": [
    { "term": "plantar fasciitis socks", "confidence": 0.97 },
    { "term": "heel pain relief sleeves", "confidence": 0.88, "contribution_pct": 0.7 }
  ],
  "llm_audit_payload": {
    "llm_model": "claude-opus-4-6",
    "llm_input_tokens": 4200,
    "llm_output_tokens": 1100
  }
}

intent_id.description: Unique-per-company slug, lowercase letters / digits / underscores.

clustering_run_id.description: Run id returned by brand_analytics_cluster_search_terms. Pass on every call for the run so the audit row is finalized.

llm_audit_payload.description: Optional. Provide on the first create_user_intent_cluster call per clustering_run_id to record model + token usage.
